author: GitHub
description:
Onboarding to a new project can take hours of reading code, but it doesn't have to. With GitHub Copilot CLI, you can simply ask for an overview, and it will scan the repository to give you a plain English breakdown. Stop digging through folders and let AI do the heavy lifting for you. 

Watch our full Copilot CLI for beginners series to learn more time-saving terminal tricks: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BDxRhhs36ns&list=PL0lo9MOBetEHvO-spzKBAITkkTqv4RvNl

author: GitHub
description:
Need to step away from your desk but want to keep working? The new remote feature for GitHub Copilot CLI lets you access your active terminal session from any device with a browser. Learn how to remote control your session allowing you to manage your work wherever and whenever you need to. 

#GitHubCopilot #CopilotCLI #AI 

Learn more about remote control Copilot CLI sessions: https://github.blog/changelog/2026-04-13-remote-control-cli-sessions-on-web-and-mobile-in-public-preview?utm_source=social-youtube-rc-cta-changelog&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=copilot-cli-remote-control-preview-april-2026
